## Summary
Describe what changed and why.

## Type
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation / CI / maintenance

## Validation
- [ ] Tests added/updated where needed
- [ ] Rust/Python tests run locally (or CI validated)
- [ ] Backward compatibility checked
- [ ] Security implications considered

## Release notes
Use a Conventional Commit PR title, e.g. `feat(ipc): add shared memory transport`.
Breaking changes use `feat!:` or add `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the commit body.
